## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `--exclude` flag breaks the project's CLI-flag policy because it has no `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` environment default, so CI cannot set it; please fix that before merging. No other defects were found in the reviewed scope.

## Changes
The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that skips files whose basename matches any pattern, logging each skipped path. It documents the flag in `docs/flags.md`, adds tests for parsing, collection and archive output, and adds a text fixture.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the `--exclude` default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — Running with `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE='*.log'` and no `--exclude` still archives `.log` files, because the flag uses `default=[]` and never reads the environment. This breaks `.claude/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`: "Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable". — CI pipelines, which set options through the environment, cannot exclude files without changing their command lines. — Fix: Build the default by splitting `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` on a documented separator, list the variable in `docs/flags.md`, and extend `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing` to cover the environment case.
